Method of Attack: Automated exploitation of Microsoft Exchange remote code execution and privilege elevation vulnerabilities (CVE-2021-34473, CVE-2021-34523, CVE-2021-31207)
Post-exploitation steps including email extraction from Active Directory and Exchange server information gathering
Maintaining SSH backdoors using reverse SSH connections (SFTP) through an Onion domain for file theft
Impacted Systems: Corporate networks of over 8,147 companies primarily in the United States
Attack Vector: Reverse SSH connections via Onion domain
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom notes and encrypted files linked to DarkSide ransomware
Jabber logs showing communications with ransomware gangs (DarkSide, REvil, LockBit)
Central panel listing compromised endpoints with victim details
